decision_logic.doc_type: Read the instrument type from the document header (H1 title, law number, or framework_code), never from the article's subject matter; map Decreto/DTO/Decreto con Fuerza de Ley to 'Decree', Lei/Ley to 'Law', codified statutes to 'Code', etc. Only override an 'unknown' value when the header explicitly names the instrument; leave it untouched if no header is visible.
